references.text: Describes two additional gold rings to be attached to the breastplate, as part of the same construction for fastening the breastplate to the ephod.
Explains how the rings on the breastplate are to be tied to the rings on the ephod with a blue cord.
The execution of the command to make two gold rings for the breastplate, as described in the instructions.
A similar construction using gold rings was used on the ark of the covenant, showing a pattern in the design of tabernacle furnishings.
The introduction of the breastplate (חֹשֶׁן) to which these rings are to be attached.
Direct continuation of the action: After the rings have been attached (39:16), the cords are connected to them here.
Complementary description: The source verse gives the upper rings, this one gives the lower; together they form the complete fastening.
Functional dependency: The chains (28:14) must be attached to the rings instructed here.
